_note: Model monitoring alert configuration. Fill in real values and run 08_alert_notification.py --channel all to actually send. When left blank, use the default simulate mode (--simulate).

feishu._note: Feishu custom bot Webhook: group settings -> group bot -> add custom bot -> copy Webhook URL

email._note: SMTP sender config (QQ/163/Gmail all require enabling SMTP and using an authorization code, not the login password)

alert_rules._note: Trigger thresholds (consistent with the industry-standard values in the README; tune to your business)
